description: This Java class provides utility routines for loading and asserting seed data in the OFBiz framework. It contains methods for loading XML data, checking values against database records, and reporting discrepancies or errors.

classes.name: EntityDataAssert
classes.description: A utility class for asserting and loading seed data, especially from XML resources, and verifying data integrity against the database.

methods.name: assertData
methods.description: Loads an XML resource from the given URL, reads the data into the delegator, checks each record, and returns the number of checked rows.

methods.name: checkValueList
methods.description: Checks a list of GenericValue objects for consistency with the database.

methods.name: checkSingleValue
methods.description: Checks a single GenericValue against the database record with the same primary key and compares fields for discrepancies.
